selection_rule: First item of each kind in the immutable v0.7 primary request, preserving original item order; chosen without using item-level scores.
process_policy: Start a fresh single-slot llama-server for every item/condition pair; cold completion is the first completion in that process and uses cache_prompt=false; warm completion immediately repeats the identical full token array with cache_prompt=true; then terminate the owned process.
cold_accounting: Require timings.cache_n=0, timings.prompt_n=input_tokens, tokens_evaluated=input_tokens, tokens_predicted=1, and truncated=false.
warm_accounting: Require timings.cache_n>0, timings.cache_n+timings.prompt_n=input_tokens, tokens_evaluated=input_tokens, tokens_predicted=1, and truncated=false.
score_definition: Natural log P(Yes) minus natural log P(No) from the same unconstrained full-vocabulary next-token distribution; preserve both log probabilities and their total literal-label mass.
analysis: Report every cold/warm score and per-label difference, cold no_yes-minus-yes_no score differences, warm no_yes-minus-yes_no differences, and interaction of these differences. No averaging, prompt selection, calibration, decoder replacement, significance test, or accuracy estimate.
failure_policy: Retain every request/response and failure; abort on contract violations, with no retry, item replacement or score substitution.
claim_limits: Four items from one previously inspected development history, same tiny quantized model. Cold/cold comparison controls prompt-cache carryover but does not establish general population behavior, accuracy, model-independent effects or a novel method. Cold/warm differences are conditional on this CPU runtime, quantized KV cache and batch schedule. First-item selection is deterministic but this diagnostic was designed after observing v0.7 aggregate instability.
